title: Personal Training Packages: shared group session availability, maximum participants, and per-participant surcharge by tier
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Personal Training Packages product line and states, for every tier, whether two members may share a single booked session, the maximum number of participants in a shared session, and the surcharge charged per additional participant in a shared session.

## Tier reference table

| Tier | Shared sessions allowed | Maximum participants in a shared session | Surcharge per additional participant (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Single Session Pack | No | 1 | 0.00 |
| 5-Session Starter Pack | No | 1 | 0.00 |
| 10-Session Value Pack | No | 1 | 0.00 |
| 20-Session Performance Pack | No | 1 | 0.00 |
| Unlimited Monthly Coaching | No | 1 | 0.00 |
| Elite Specialty Coaching | Yes | 2 | 40.00 |

## Points of reference
Elite Specialty Coaching is the sole tier of Personal Training Packages that allows two members to share a single booked session, capping participation at 2 and charging 40.00 dollars for the additional participant. Every other tier caps a booked session at 1 participant and does not allow session sharing.
